summary: Security update for the Linux Kernel (Live Patch 4 for SUSE Linux Enterprise 15 SP7)
details:
This update for the SUSE Linux Enterprise Kernel 6.4.0-150700.53.16 fixes one security issue

The following security issue was fixed:

- CVE-2026-43284: xfrm: esp: avoid in-place decrypt on shared skb frags (bsc#1264459).
